title: AETHER Phase 5 — temporal event-log prototype

dataset.name: sx-askubuntu — temporal Ask Ubuntu network
dataset.license_or_terms: Não foi localizada licença/termos específicos para sx-askubuntu. A BSD é para o software SNAP e não foi atribuída aos dados.
dataset.direction: directed; original event arcs are preserved; no reverse arcs are added
dataset.official_event_semantics: Cada linha SRC DST UNIXTS representa uma interação dirigida: resposta de u à pergunta de v, comentário de u na pergunta de v ou comentário de u na resposta de v. Eventos agregam os subgrafos a2q, c2q e c2a.

transforms: each raw event remains a distinct log row, including repeated interactions
event application is directed and uses operation='add'; repeated edge events are no-op graph updates but remain in history
internal node IDs are relabelled only if original IDs fall outside the declared 0..n-1 range; this is recorded in parsed metadata
if input timestamps are not non-decreasing, events are stably sorted by (timestamp, original row order)
the public dataset contains interaction events, not relation deletions; removal support is tested separately by the prototype tests

architecture.live_state: one mutable compact Python adjacency graph
architecture.event_log: parallel arrays: uint64 timestamp, uint32 source, uint32 target, uint8 operation; sequence index is array position
architecture.historical_state: reconstructed on demand by replay through the selected timestamp; no historical graph snapshots are cached

limitations: The event log supports add and remove records, but the selected SNAP temporal dataset supplies interaction/add events only; its timestamped events are not observed deletions.
Historical reconstruction is O(number of events up to the queried time); without checkpoints, old-state queries can become expensive.
The memory figures use Python sys.getsizeof estimates for adjacency and array capacities; allocator fragmentation and process RSS are reported separately.
Snapshot comparison keeps five selected reconstructed graph objects simultaneously to estimate the cost of materializing history; it does not retain these snapshots in the prototype itself.
The source pages do not publish dataset-specific license terms; unknown status is preserved rather than inferring the software SNAP BSD license for the data.
Only five temporal checkpoints were sampled; the slowest reconstruction is reported as the maximum observed, not as a P95 estimate.
